description: This bar chart, titled "MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix," compares the accuracy percentages of two models, MMAU (blue bars) and MMAR (purple bars), across four different benchmarks: "Construct," "Audio-Reasoner," "Qwen-2.5-Omni," and an unlabeled fourth category on the far left. The vertical y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranges from 0 to 100 in increments of 10, with a linear scale. The horizontal x-axis lists the four benchmark categories. The chart displays grouped bars for each benchmark, with the blue bar representing MMAU and the purple bar representing MMAR. For the "Construct" benchmark, MMAU achieves approximately 55% accuracy while MMAR achieves approximately 40%. For the "Audio-Reasoner" benchmark, MMAU achieves approximately 75% accuracy while MMAR achieves approximately 60%. For the "Qwen-2.5-Omni" benchmark, MMAU achieves approximately 85% accuracy while MMAR achieves approximately 80%. The fourth benchmark on the far left shows MMAU at approximately 55% accuracy and MMAR at approximately 40%. The bars are not sorted by value; they appear in the order listed on the x-axis. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner indicating the color coding for the models.
